business: Ridgeline Staffing Partners, Inc. (Light-Industrial & Skilled-Trades Staffing)

redFlags: Owner compensation above market: Partially supportable. The owner runs sales for the two largest accounts and would have to be replaced by a branch president and a senior recruiter. Only about $168,000 of the $306,000 claim exceeds the cost of that replacement team.

Subcontracted recruiting support (claimed one-time): Unsupported. Management presents this as a temporary bridge during a hiring gap, but account 6460 posts in all 36 months at a steady rate and is still running in December 2025.

Workers' compensation accrual shortfall (buyer adjustment): Buyer-identified downward adjustment. Workers' compensation expense in account 6120 has been held essentially flat for three years while revenue and field headcount grew 25%. Normalising the accrual to the current experience modifier and payroll base reduces supported adjusted EBITDA by roughly $162,000.
Customer concentration: Largest customer, Cedar Municipal Authority, is 21.8% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 66.7%.
yellowFlags: Applicant tracking system implementation: Fully supportable. A discrete two-month implementation in May and June 2025 with no activity in the account in any other month.
Tri-Cities branch closure severance: Fully supportable. One posting in February 2025 tied to the closure of a single branch, with no recurrence in the ten months since.

Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $-26,602 to $209,610; cash ranges from $2,432,917 to $3,107,714. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
greenFlags: Verified TTM Revenue of $17.06M across VDR financials.
Reported TTM EBITDA of $1.46M reconciled against tax returns and bank statements.
